VALUERS, APPRAISERS, ESTATE AGENTS AND PROPERTY MANAGERS ACT 1981

VALUATION AND PROPERTY SERVICES (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) RULES 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 8 of the
Valuers, Appraisers, Estate Agents and Property Man agers Act 1981  [Act 242 ], the
Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Valuation and Property Services
(Amendment) (No. 2) Rules 2018.

(2)  These Rules come into operation on 2 June 2018.

Amendment of Second Schedule
2. The Valuation and Property Services Rules 1999 [ P.U. (A) 382/1999] are amended
in the Second Schedule by substituting for  Form S the following forms:
